docs.gateway_call:
Execute one admitted role operation and retain its original call identity.

The authenticated edge envelope carries the admitted session, capability,
operation, arguments and stable call_id. context.read reports safe repository
registration readiness. Repository policy comes from the exact Project
registration or one enabled server-approved repository/environment template;
templates derive separate Project workspaces and grant no IT approval.
Physical dependency verification requires a separate exact Project/SRS
policy or its existing Project registration. Malformed or conflicting
policy registrations are denied before a native dependency read.
Missing or conflicting registrations return a useful prerequisite error.
context.read also reports supported artifact extensions, byte limits and
immutable filename rules. New artifact.write arguments are validated before
conversation binding or a write intent. Existing receipts remain unchanged;
failures after an intent retain uncertainty and never authorize replay.
docs.invoke:
Invoke one versioned Project specialist under current ERP authorization.

Architect dispatch includes exact plan metadata for its governance invocation,
canonical ERP Project URL, SRS revision/hash and registered Project/role binding.
The outer AutomationRun keeps its separate transport identity. Existing packet
and result validation remains authoritative.
